editorial:
Nick Hume seems to have it all: a steady job, a loving family, and a quiet routine. That peace shatters when a random act of violence takes his son, and grief pushes him toward a dangerous path. What starts as a normal family drama quickly turns into a gritty revenge story, with Nick trading his safe life for a darker mission. The movie feels tense and personal, focusing on how far one father will go when the system fails him. You can feel his pain in every scene, and the story keeps pulling you deeper into his choices.

The action is rough and close-up, with fights that feel messy rather than polished. Kevin Bacon carries the film with raw emotion, making Nick believable even when his decisions get extreme. The pacing moves fast once the revenge begins, though some moments can feel heavy and upsetting. If you like dark thrillers and do not mind violence, this is a strong pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nick tracks down Billy, the gang leader, and kills him after a brutal fight. By then, Nick has lost his other son and his wife is badly hurt, so his victory feels empty. He does not walk away clean; the movie ends with him paying the ultimate price for his revenge, leaving the family broken and the cycle of violence complete.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark revenge thrillers and intense action.
